changes: 9.3, after an independent review: Still open has 18 questions. Where the Handbook or this page already decides (short messages, loading and error pages, text in another language, the cards / list switch, repeating events), the answer is in the comparison tables.

Questions 8 and 9 start with the recommended answer in one line. Case 4 (sign-ups closed) is no longer in the recommended words.

Compared with the live app: details the first version had dropped are back (the live words for joining an event, 15-minute times, sorting members by role, the two live words for a private group, Google and GitHub sign-in, and more).

Your answers of 13 October in the Agreed rules: the redesign ships in twelve parts, one by one; the language switch "LV ▾" stays in the header on every page; a slim footer on discovery and reading pages; screens not drawn follow the rules on this page.

Also from 13 October: an event's place is a required city plus a free address ("Tiešsaistē" for online); faces of who is going only for signed-in viewers; "Atsaukt pieteikumu"; no "Mani pasākumi" tab; social links at the end of Informācija.
Drawn from the rules, as proposals: the event's own page, Biedri, a group's Jaunumi, Mans profils, and the group's "…" menu.
Questions 4 and 8 redone as pictures: events you can't simply join (four cases, An event) and the team's waiting join requests (two ways, Your own area). They are Still open 8 and 9.

New section near the end, "Compared with the live app": every live screen, every live feature the page didn't mention, every difference with its verdict, the data work with migrations marked, and the build order.
Fixed: the shield menu rule said the live link already reads "Administrēšanas panelis"; it still reads "Admina panelis".
The page is now generated by scripts/redesign (npm run redesign:build); every copy of an element comes from one template.
